config.units: SI in solver; imported CAD hardpoints converted from mm

sprung_components.basis: Unweighed total allowance including frame, pack, seat and body; do not add those masses again
Rigid payload hypothesis; segment motion and actual seated centre of mass unmeasured

spring_assumptions.basis: Front rate from illustrative sag calculation, not the offered 750-marked coil. Rear linear surrogate is NOT an air-shock force curve. All damping and end-stop curves are unmeasured. Rear axial TSDA does not enforce the separate guided-roll eye proposal.

drive_assumptions.basis: Temporary output limits at locked rear axle; NOT verified motor/controller/battery ratings. Motor electrical and thermal states absent; no current result permitted.

contact.model: NSC rigid cylindrical tyre envelopes on rigid dry ground
contact.basis: Uncalibrated coefficient. No pneumatic compliance, tread deformation, rolling resistance, sand or water. Vehicle self-contact disabled; separate CAD swept-clearance checks remain required.

tyre_screen_override.collision_model: Four whole-tyre rigid cylinders, radius 0.183 m and width 0.137 m
tyre_screen_override.mass_and_inertia: All mass assumptions retained. Existing cylinder/spool surrogate inertia equations recompute with the new radius and width; measured wheel inertia remains unknown.
tyre_screen_override.initial_height: All imported hardpoints receive radius + 2 mm world translation; source tyre raises neutral initial assembly by 5.2 mm.
unchanged_assumptions: Sprung masses and rigid 20 kg payload
Wheel, upright, carrier and spool masses
Scenario durations and corrected acceptance gates
not_modelled: Exact 6 inch rim barrel and brake fit
New body-kit collision or new body mass
Measured tyre friction, rolling resistance and soil response
tyre_screen_override.published_load_boundary: Manufacturer publishes 35 kg per tyre at 25 kPa / 4 psi for this variant. No matched tyre/wheel operating load is selected. Separate 100 kg parked support plus curb mass is unqualified; these runs use only the existing rigid 20 kg payload.

metrics.interpretation: Mandatory development maneuver coverage; speed/hold/steering evaluated only at recorded samples, path is sampled 3D chassis travel. Between-sample excursions and physical braking qualification are unestablished.
metrics.stop_speed_basis: Magnitude of chassis COM world linear velocity, including lateral and vertical motion

chassis.basis: Lumped registered sprung masses and rigid payload, NOT complete CAD inertia

FL_lower.basis: Two nominal steel arm tubes; attachment/joint masses omitted

FL_upper.basis: Two nominal steel arm tubes; attachment/joint masses omitted

FL_wheel.basis: Uniform rigid cylinder mass surrogate; tyre/rim/hub inertias unmeasured

FL_relay.basis: Relay allowance with exact study pivot and pickup locations

FR_lower.basis: Two nominal steel arm tubes; attachment/joint masses omitted

FR_upper.basis: Two nominal steel arm tubes; attachment/joint masses omitted

FR_wheel.basis: Uniform rigid cylinder mass surrogate; tyre/rim/hub inertias unmeasured

FR_relay.basis: Relay allowance with exact study pivot and pickup locations

rear_carrier.basis: Unweighed motor, jackshaft and carrier lump; rotor inertia not represented

rear_spool.basis: Locked axle and two wheels; approximate wheel-dominated inertia

rear_link_0.basis: Nominal section volume at generic steel density; ends and joint hardware excluded

rear_link_1.basis: Nominal section volume at generic steel density; ends and joint hardware excluded

rear_link_2.basis: Nominal section volume at generic steel density; ends and joint hardware excluded

rear_link_3.basis: Nominal section volume at generic steel density; ends and joint hardware excluded

missing_models: Measured masses and full CAD inertia
Actual damper/air spring curves and mount/eye constraints
Self contact, body kit, chain, main harness and brake hose contact
Motor current, battery, controller and thermal dynamics
Sand, slopes, water, fault injection and physical correlation
qualification: Archived simplified Chrono model, distinct from the Ridge and AG23 CAD. Saved outcomes and assumed inputs are retained; no physical qualification.
